lessons_used: No onboarding changes tested achieved a statistically significant win.
Predictions were frequently too optimistic, though some negative predictions were overly pessimistic.
Split-screen persona selection redesigns significantly worsened performance.
Adding background processing desktop alert systems significantly worsened performance.
Reordering sign-in to after friend selection significantly worsened performance.
Copy updates, layout redesigns, new screens, hints, checklists, and wait indicators showed no clear effect.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Shortcut Guidance Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new interactive tutorial screen right after home_intro showing how to click, move, and control the desktop pet via shortcut keys.
candidates.why: Support tickets show 3 users confused about how to control or hide the pet, and finish step drop-off is high (64.8%).

new_desktop_controls_tutorial.headline: How to Control Your Desktop Pet
new_desktop_controls_tutorial.body: Use Alt+P to show or hide your companion anytime. Double-click your pet to open quick actions.

components.text: Alt + P toggles pet visibility instantly.

guard.reason: Adds a valid new tutorial screen after home_intro without removing required steps or violating base rules.

candidates.score_note: New screens on the finish step historically decreased conversion by 9.1%.

candidates.title: List Layout Redesign for Companion Selection
candidates.change: Redesigns the pick_friend screen with a list layout displaying each companion alongside sound clips and trait badges.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%) in the core creation phase and standard selection layout has high abandon times.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion Archetype
pick_friend.body: Select a pet persona that best matches your daily workspace dynamic.

pet_choices.label: Playful Dog / Calm Cat / Energetic Dragon

guard.reason: 'pick_friend.replace.pet_choices[0].label' must be text up to 40 characters

candidates.title: Interactive Hatching Activity Flow on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Replaces static waiting screen experience with an interactive pet egg tapping activity while custom pet generation runs in the background.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a high median wait time of 201 seconds and users frequently drop off or drop in engagement.

waiting.headline: Your Pet is Hatching!
waiting.body: Tap the egg below while we build your custom 3D companion desktop model.

guard.reason: Replaces waiting screen components with an interactive activity while continuing to show pet generation progress.

candidates.score_note: Complex interactive flow redesigns have high build cost and negative precedent.

candidates.title: Stage Layout Redesign for Choose Path Screen
candidates.change: Redesigns the path selection screen using a stage layout with animated character previews for predefined vs custom creation paths.
candidates.why: The choose_path screen takes an unexpectedly long mean time of 514s and drops 23.8% of onboarding users.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Creation Journey
choose_path.body: Pick a ready-made desktop companion or build a unique pet from photo uploads.

path_options.label: Instant Ready Pet vs Custom Photo Creation

guard.reason: 'choose_path.replace.path_options[0].label' must be text up to 40 characters

candidates.title: Account Persistence Explainer Hint on Sign-In
candidates.change: Adds an explicit explanatory hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in links pets permanently across desktop re-installs.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets (largest issue group) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again or re-logging.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your primary email to ensure your pet attributes and customized items never get lost.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Background Generation Mascot Speech Indicator on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Adds dynamic mascot speech bubble hints on the waiting screen updating users on specific rendering stages.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes a mean time of 2336s and 3 users reported custom pet generation failures or desktop display issues.

components.text: Polishing 3D animations and configuring desktop overlay settings...

guard.reason: Adds dynamic mascot rendering updates on the waiting screen while preserving its primary function.

candidates.score_note: Wait info updates on home step showed consistent slight positive lift (+1.0%).

candidates.title: Desktop Display Verification Copy on Adoption Certificate
candidates.change: Updates adoption certificate headline and hint to clarify that the pet will spawn in the bottom right corner of the desktop.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted pet does not show on desktop after onboarding completion.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your companion is registered! It will appear floating near your system tray once setup completes.
adoption_certificate.hint: If your desktop pet is hidden behind full-screen apps, press Alt+P to bring it to the front.

guard.reason: Updates copy on adoption certificate while preserving the screen's core job and official certificate context.

candidates.score_note: Cheap copy-only fix, but adoption copy changes previously yielded -2.3%.

candidates.title: Stage Layout Redesign on Final Home Intro
candidates.change: Changes home_intro layout to stage format featuring a live pet animation badge and glowing completion call-to-action button.
candidates.why: Finish step drops 35.2% of users right before completing the full onboarding flow.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Companion is Ready!
home_intro.body: Click below to send your pet onto your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Redesigns home_intro stage layout within allowed onboarding modifications.

candidates.score_note: Finish layout tweaks previously achieved a +3.7% relative conversion boost.

candidates.title: Exclusive Desktop Animation Perk Hint on Path Choice
candidates.change: Adds an incentive badge on path choice screen highlighting exclusive custom animations unlocked upon completion.
candidates.why: Only 76.2% of users complete choose_path, which is the very first action step of onboarding.

choose_path.hint: Completing onboarding unlocks 3 exclusive celebration animations for your pet!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions 'Free Animation Pack', violating the rule prohibiting mentions of free extras or pricing.

candidates.title: Desktop Sound Notification Cue on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Adds an option to trigger a sound chime and desktop audio cue when pet rendering finishes.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean time is over 38 minutes (2336s), suggesting users switch windows while waiting.

guard.reason: Adds sound notification options to the waiting screen within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Desktop audio/notification additions explicitly worsened performance in prior tests.

lessons_next: Desktop tray icon navigation copy on the home intro screen and list layout redesigns for friend selection achieved statistically significant wins.
Split-screen persona selection redesigns, background desktop alerts, and reordering sign-in to after friend selection significantly worsened performance.
Hints, wait time indicators, new screens, and new activity flows showed no clear effect.
Initial predictions were often too optimistic for positive changes, while some negative predictions were overly pessimistic.
